title: Verdanti booxal safreynit
intro: dumaahi waktil, namma num cuggaane baaxooxa dacrisak sugen. Ken gititte ittat axawah sugteeh, uxih ken sorkocô baxi baxaabaxsale madmoomi fan ken miraacise. Inkitti massat yan gita gexaah, gersitti angodda diteh addat hoxe. Atu ta namma gaaboyso dacrisa marih cuumi baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu mango daro liyo, wagitah yan marih intiita dirabboysa assakat le gaaboyna.
Yi cuggaane yok muxxi kaxxa acwa leeh, uxih anu inniimih muxxi ken exxa niyaata.
Anu kusaaqiseh nanu ken daro inki gabuuk baysenno, kullim yi lowsiisih gubat maqarrosnuh.
Anu inni gaaboysoh amol finqa baahe, inni duquurinna ekraaroh addat kullim finqiseh.
Anu cato sinnim sooleh yi murtitte kafteh yi gaddi inki bar qaane fan korte wak.
Anu akeerat saami luk masugiyyooh, yok ellecabo gub cararta girah boodo akkele.
